stem: Write 7/20 as a percentage. The first steps are done.
scaffold: Step 6: make the bottom 100. 20 × 5 = 100, so multiply the top by 5 as well: 7 × 5 = …
hint: Work out 7 × 5. That many out of 100 is the percentage.
working: Step 6: make the bottom 100. 20 × 5 = 100, so multiply the top by 5 as well: 7 × 5 = 35. 7/20 = 35/100 = 35%.

misconceptions.message: You kept the top as it was. Whatever you do to the bottom, do to the top: 7 × 5.
You added 5 to the top. Multiply, do not add.
That is 7 ÷ 2. The bottom went × 5, so the top does too.

stem: Write 0.45 as a fraction in its simplest form. The first step is done.
scaffold: Step 5: read the place value. 0.45 is 45 hundredths, so 45/100. …
hint: Which number divides into both 45 and 100?
working: Step 5: read the place value. 0.45 is 45 hundredths, so 45/100. Simplify: 5 divides into both. 45 ÷ 5 = 9 and 100 ÷ 5 = 20, so 9/20.

misconceptions.message: Right so far, but not simplified. Divide top and bottom by 5.
You dropped a digit. 0.45 is 45 hundredths, not 4 fifths.
0.45 has two decimal places, so it is hundredths, not tenths.

hint: Divide 5 by 8 with short division first.

misconceptions.message: You copied the digits. 5/8 is not 0.58. Divide 5 by 8.
That is the decimal. Multiply by 100 for the percentage.
One place short. Multiply the decimal by 100, so two places.

working: This is percentage of an amount. 10% of 60 = 6. 30% = 18. 5% = 3. 35% = 18 + 3 = 21. So £21.

misconceptions.message: You took 35 from 60. Find 35% of it: build it from 10% blocks.
That is 10% of 60. You need three of those and a half of one.
You multiplied by 35. Per cent means out of 100, so 35% is 35/100.

stem: Three shops sell the same trainers at the same full price. Shop A takes 1/4 off, shop B takes 0.3 off and shop C takes 27% off. Which shop takes the most off? Answer A, B or C.
hint: Turn all three into percentages first.
working: All as percentages: 1/4 = 25%, 0.3 = 30%, 27%. The biggest is 30%, so shop (b).

misconceptions.message: 1/4 is 25%. Both 0.3 and 27% are bigger than that.
27% beats 25%, but 0.3 is 30%, which is more.
